text:
maya: Heads-up: we just promoted Auto-Quant Select (AQS) to Hosted default for generation models with <1B-parameter and 1-4k seqs. Canary ran 36h across eu-west/us-west. Results: token-cost -28% average, median latency -7%, p99 latency +3% on long-seq tails. Rolling to 15% traffic now.

maya: Why this matters: AQS chooses INT8/4-bit kernels and a compatible microkernel at request time based on seq length + prompt shape. For many customer workloads that are short-ish, this avoids unnecessary fp16 passes.

tom: awesome. any impact on embeddings or reranking endpoints?

maya: Embeddings unaffected (we keep fp16 for semantic accuracy). Reranking: currently opt-in; we didn't enable AQS there due to sensitivity of small-score deltas.

ops-bot: deploy: canary started by maya at 2245701185 targeting hosted-prod (15% traffic). Summary: https://deploys.redwood/internal/2245701185

ira: quick numbers pls for chat vs single-turn. want to verify multi-turn retention & p95 boost.

maya: chat (conversational flows): median -5%, p95 -3%, p99 +2% (within 200ms soft SLO). Single-turn short prompts: median -12%, p95 -18%. Long single-turn (>=2k tokens): p99 +9% on 2 models with known large-kernel slowdowns.

derek: flag: one of the large-kernel variants showed increased memory churn leading to rare OOM-ish reconnects in canary. I filed infra ticket: https://issues.redwood/INF-4829

maya: thanks derek. we toggled a per-model safety cap to avoid that variant for sequences >3k until we ship a kernel patch.

tom: can we publish a quick RFC for AQS override knobs? customers may want to pin quant level or disallow 4-bit.

maya: yes. short doc: https://go.redwood/aqs-config. Example overrides: ```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","aqs":{"enabled":false}}
```
or to force a quant level:
```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","aqs":{"force_quant":"int8"}}
```

ira: monitoring ask: create an alert for model OOM reconnects + p99 delta >12% sustained 20m.

maya: added. Alert: AQS-p99-regress and AQS-ooms. If AQS-p99-regress fires, automatic rollback to previous quant policy for affected model group.

infra-bot: metric snapshot (canary): mean_token_cost: -28.3%, median_latency_ms: -7.1%, p99_latency_ms: +3.2% (models impacted: m-small-v2, m-eng-legacy). Link: https://metrics.redwood/canaries/2245701185

derek: ops note: Dedicated stays locked to customer-specified quant/compile settings. No changes to Dedicated default.

maya: rollout plan: 15% -> 40% in 6h if no alert; 40% -> 100% over 48h if stable. Immediate rollback if oom reconnects >3 or AQS-p99-regress fires for >20m.

tom: nice win overall. can we get a short blurb for the weekly all-hands with cost savings estimate?

maya: will write one. estimate: ~$0.9M/year if current traffic mix holds and AQS hits global avg -28% token cost.

ira: attaching a sample anomalous payload from canary that triggered a reconnect (sanitized): ```{"user":"sanitized","prompt_len":3240,"model":"m-eng-legacy"}```

maya: appreciated. I'll follow up with kernel team and post a patch ETA in #eng-runtime. Thanks team :sparkles:
